subject: Was Geto a jujutsu sorcerer or a curse user, and did that change?

beats.title: Plot Details
beats.text: On December 7th, 1989, Satoru Gojo was born. Back then, jujutsu sorcerers were too busy with cursed spirits to go after villainous curse users. Sorcerers like Ogami and Awasaka could kill and make money as hitmen all they wanted. This was the status quo until Satoru Gojo changed everything. A hit was put out on him at a young age, but Awasaka and Ogami understood exactly how dangerous he was from one glance from the Six Eyes. Awasaka and the other curse users cooperating with Pseudo-Geto are doing so because they had their freedom stolen from them by Gojo's mere presence in the world. Awasaka rejects retirement and continues to fight because he'll always trample over the weak until the day he dies.

beats.title: Synopsis / Cursed Child Arc
beats.text: When Suguru Geto and his followers invaded Tokyo Jujutsu High, despite being a grade 2 sorcerer, Ino was among the semi-grade 1 or above sorcerers gathered by Masamichi Yaga to confront the curse users. He later attended the meeting along with Nanami as the sorcerers discussed their plan for the upcoming war. During the Night Parade of a Hundred Demons, Ino fought at the frontlines in Shinjuku, exorcising several curses and a giant curse by himself. Since Nanami was stationed in Kyoto, Ino was disappointed that his mentor was unable to see his performance. He was quickly reprimanded by Atsuya Kusakabe for idling around.(Movie 0)

beats.title: Abilities and Powers / Overview
beats.text: Overall Skill Level: Suguru Geto was one of just four special grade sorcerers and was deemed the worst of all curse users due to the level of danger he presented to humanity.(Chapter 0-2)

beats.title: Overview
beats.text: A curse user is an evil human sorcerer who uses jujutsu with evil intent.(Chapter 21, Episode 9) Naturally, they have existed as long as jujutsu sorcerers have, and were also prominent threats during the Heian Era alongside cursed spirits.(Chapter 82, Episode 31)

beats.title: Aftermath
beats.doc_title: Yuta Okkotsu & Toge Inumaki vs. Cursed Spirits
beats.text: Still injured, Yuta ignores the pain and stares in amazement at Toge's power. Toge runs over to check on his peer and shows signs of concern despite not being able to directly communicate. Yuta understands Toge and suggests that he's fine despite bleeding from his head. Toge offers Yuta another high five and this time Yuta gladly returns the act of kindness. Watching from above, Suguru Geto is disappointed his curse failed to force Rika out of Yuta. Geto did manage to take Yuta's ID card and can't wait to meet is fellow special grade sorcerer face to face.(Volume 0) After the mission, Ijichi apologizes to Gojo for not having enough thorough research on the mission site. He never expected another curtain to appear or a semi-grade 1 curse. Gojo explains that Ijichi isn't at fault because he was outclassed Suguru Geto cast a barrier over Ijichi's and spawned the unidentified curse. Gojo reminds Ijichi that Geto is the worst curse user, the man expelled from Jujutsu High for killing over a hundred civilians.(Volume 0)

beats.title: Plot Details
beats.text: The first type of non-sorcerers marked are vessels Geto had ingest cursed objects similar to how Yuji incarnated Sukuna. The second type are those whose brains were meant to be non-sorcerers like Junpei Yoshino. Idle Transfiguration allowed Pseudo-Geto to adjust their brains for the capacity to use jujutsu and develop innate techniques. To those who've ingested cursed objects, Geto gave them the strength to be proper vessels.

beats.title: Plot Details
beats.text: In a flashback, Geto is seen talking to Mahito, Hanami and Jogo about how Tengen's barrier changes positions everyday. Jogo asks who's Tengen as Geto replies they are an immortal sorcerer, Jogo gets excited over this and asks again who's stronger, Tengen or Satoru Gojo. Geto explains that they don't need to worry about them. When Hanami asks about why don't they seal Gojo within the veil, Geto explains that they don't want to direct his attention to Mahito's main mission. Geto believes that one of the students acts as a landmine for Sukuna, and if they were to kill the student, all of their current plans will be ruined. Jogo suggests for them to kidnap Sukuna's vessel but Geto says Sukuna is a bomb for both them and Jujutsu High.

beats.title: Abilities and Powers
beats.text:
Overall Skill Level: As a special grade vengeful cursed spirit, Rika's power was unmatched in terms of pure destructive potential. A fully manifested Rika was considered a grave threat by the jujutsu higher-ups, to the point where they doubted if even Satoru Gojo could contain her. By only manifesting her arms she could easily bring harm to non-sorcerers and jujutsu sorcerers alike. Once Yuta trusted his connection with her enough to allow her to fully manifest, Rika's power eclipsed that of nearly all other curses.

Suguru Geto, a curse manipulator with well over four thousand cursed spirits in his possession believes that Rika is without a doubt the undisputed Queen of Curses. He risked everything to gain her power and had he been successful, Geto expected to have exactly what he needed to destroy all non-sorcerers.(Chapter 0-4)

With Rika's aid, Yuta was able to defeat Geto and overpower all the cursed spirits he threw at them. She supported him with physical attacks and used her speed to keep him from danger. To counter Geto's Maximum: Uzumaki, Yuta broke the limits on Rika's cursed energy, making her more powerful than ever before.(Chapter 0-4) However, following the bout, this resulted in the curse unraveling from Rika's spirit completely after she decided not to punish Yuta for severing the bond.(Chapter 0-4)
